correctness.rationale: For all integers d≥2,q≥3, the unique invariant cut/cycle projections minimize across ℓp by group averaging. A product graph Laplacian factorization and exact heat kernel give radial potentials with positive differences; binomial summation yields cut-column ℓ1 norm (d+1)(q−1)/q. Edge-transitivity and rank give the diagonal, hence complementary cycle norm; self-adjointness gives ℓ∞. Independently solved exact rational Poisson systems and 281 exact-rational identities support the proof without replacing its universal quantifiers. Theorem 43 is the explicitly cited external premise.

value.rationale: The formulas close a natural nonbinary two-parameter endpoint classification in graph-cycle Banach geometry, with exact minimal projection costs for the full edge cut and cycle spaces. The problem is motivated by a prior article centered on this very Hamming family, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The sharp q dependence and the simultaneous ℓp optimality have concrete structural content.
